notes: 4-channel, 4000W network amplifier for Q-SYS. Two RJ45 Q-LAN ports (LAN A required, LAN B optional/redundant) carry Q-SYS audio transport and control over standard gigabit Ethernet (per QSC datasheet "gigabit Ethernet protocols and hardware"); graded eth-1g. Four Mic/Line inputs use 3-pin Euroblock connectors (balanced or unbalanced), +12V phantom power switchable per channel in Q-SYS Designer. Four speaker outputs share a single 8-pin Euroblock connector block (2 pins per channel, A-D); channels can be bridged/paralleled in Q-SYS Designer for higher voltage/current (not modeled as separate ports here since the physical connector is fixed). GPIO is a single 16-pin Euroblock connector carrying 8 bidirectional GPIO lines plus 3.3V, ground, and relay (NO/COM/NC) pins - modeled here as one bidirectional euroblock control port. AC inlet is a locking IEC C14 (rear-panel locking IEC C-14, universal 100-240VAC 50/60Hz with active PFC). Sourced from QSC/Q-SYS official datasheet (qsys.com PDF) and official CX-Q/CX-Qn User Manual (TD-001586-01-B, qscaudio.com), both authoritative manufacturer sources. Unit is 2RU rack-mount, 3.5 x 19 x 16 in.
